$comment: Starlight Engine Addon Manifest Template. Adheres to ADR-SL-008, 009, 018, 021. Note: Root envelope fields for .addon (descriptor GUID vs packageId) are subject to Candidate ADR-SL-026 (Proposed / Pending Approval).
name: Platformer Movement Behavior
author: Starlight Engine Authors
description: Standard 2D platformer movement behavior with jump, double-jump and wall-cling support.

aces.name: Jump
aces.description: Makes the instance perform a jump if grounded or allowed.

aces.name: Is Moving
aces.description: Tests if the instance has non-zero horizontal velocity.

aces.name: Speed
aces.description: Returns current horizontal speed in pixels per second.
